```artifact
Feature: Admin functionality for managing labs and chemists
  Background: Admin is logged in and has access to the system

  #1 Add a new Speciality (Requirement U11_4)
  Scenario: Add a new unique Speciality
    Given the system is in an empty state
    When the Admin adds a new Speciality with the name "General Medicine"
    Then the system should create the Speciality and display a confirmation message
    Examples:
      | name             | confirmation message |
      | "General Medicine" | "Speciality added successfully" |

  #2 Update doctor information (Requirement U11_5)
    Given the system has a doctor record
    When the Admin updates the doctor's information
    Then the system should reflect the changes and display a confirmation message
    Examples:
      | info             | confirmation message       |
      | {name: "John Doe", age: 30} | "Doctor information updated" |

  #3 Maintain Specialities (Requirement Req-1)
    #1 Add a new Speciality
      Given a new Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        When the Admin adds "Pediatrics"
        Then the system should create the Speciality and display a confirmation message
      And the system should show an empty list of doctors for "Pediatrics"
      And the system should allow adding doctors to "Pediatrics"

    #2 View and Update the details of an existing Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        When the Admin updates the name to "Pediatric Medicine"
        Then the system should update the Speciality and display a confirmation message
      And the system should show the updated list of doctors for "Pediatric Medicine"

    #3 Delete a Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatric Medicine"
        And there are no doctors associated with "Pediatric Medicine"
        When the Admin attempts to delete "Pediatric Medicine"
        Then the system should prevent deletion and display an error message

  #4 Maintain Doctors (Requirement Req-2)
    #1 Add a Doctor to a Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        When the Admin adds a Doctor named "Jane Smith" to "Pediatrics"
        Then the system should associate "Jane Smith" with "Pediatrics"
        And the system should show the updated list of doctors for "Pediatrics"

    #2 Associate a Doctor with a Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        And there is a Doctor named "Jane Smith"
        When the Admin associates "Jane Smith" with "Pediatrics"
        Then the system should associate "Jane Smith" with "Pediatrics"
        And the system should show the updated list of doctors for "Pediatrics"

    #3 Remove a Doctor from a Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        And there is a Doctor named "Jane Smith" associated with "Pediatrics"
        When the Admin removes "Jane Smith" from "Pediatrics"
        Then the system should remove "Jane Smith" and display a confirmation message
        And the system should show the updated list of doctors for "Pediatrics"

  #5 Handle Speciality and Doctor associations
    #1 Valid Doctor and No Existing Speciality
      Given the system has no Speciality
        And the Admin adds a Doctor named "Alice Brown"
        When the Admin attempts to add "Alice Brown" to a non-existing Speciality
        Then the system should create the Speciality and associate "Alice Brown"
        And the system should show the created Speciality with "Alice Brown"

    #2 Valid Doctor and Existing Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        And the Admin adds a Doctor named "Bob Davis" to "Pediatrics"
        Then the system should associate "Bob Davis" with "Pediatrics"
        And the system should show the Speciality with "Bob Davis"

    #3 Invalid Speciality and No Existing Doctor
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Invalid Specialty"
        And the Admin attempts to associate a Doctor named "Charlie Green" with "Invalid Specialty"
        Then the system should reject the association and display an error message

    #4 Valid Doctor and Existing Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
        And the Admin removes a Doctor named "Bob Davis" from "Pediatrics"
        Then the system should remove "Bob Davis"
        And the system should show the Speciality without "Bob Davis"

  #6 Error paths and boundary values
    #1 Empty System State
      Given the system is in an empty state
      When the Admin attempts to add a Speciality
      Then the system should prevent deletion and display an error message

    #2 Existing Doctor Record
      Given the system has a doctor record
        And the Admin updates the doctor's information
          | info             | update details       | confirmation message       |
          | {name: "John Doe", age: 30} | {name: "John Doe", age: 35} | "Doctor information updated" |
      And the system should reflect the changes and display a confirmation message

    #3 Speciality with No Associated Doctors
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "General Medicine"
          And there are no doctors associated with "General Medicine"
          When the Admin attempts to delete "General Medicine"
          Then the system should prevent deletion and display an error message

    #4 Speciality with Associated Doctors
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
          And there is a Doctor named "Jane Smith" associated with "Pediatrics"
          When the Admin attempts to delete "Pediatrics"
          Then the system should prevent deletion and display an error message

    #5 Valid Doctor and Invalid Speciality
      Given the system has a valid Speciality
          And the Admin attempts to associate a Doctor with an invalid Speciality
          And the Speciality does not exist
          When the Admin tries to associate "Charlie Green"
          Then the system should reject the association and display an error message

    #6 Doctor Associated with a Speciality
      Given the system has a Speciality with the name "Pediatrics"
          And the Admin associates a Doctor named "Jane Smith" with "Pediatrics"
          When the Admin removes "Jane Smith" from "Pediatrics"
          Then the system should remove "Jane Smith"
          And the system should show the Speciality without "Jane Smith"

  #7 Parser Error
    Given a Gherkin parse error
    When the parser encounters an error
    Then it should report the error clearly

```
